UI_trait_Numb_Desc: Panic, stress, unhappiness, boredom, and discomfort are fully suppressed.
UI_trait_Apathetic_Desc: Panic near-suppressed. Stress, unhappiness, boredom, and discomfort are strongly limited. Corpse handling no longer affects mood.
UI_trait_Detached_Desc: Panic ceiling lowered further. Stress, unhappiness, boredom, and discomfort are limited. Corpse handling no longer affects mood.
UI_trait_Calloused_Desc: Panic ceiling lowered. Stress, unhappiness, boredom, and discomfort are moderately limited. Corpse handling no longer affects mood.
UI_trait_Hardened_Desc: Panic ceiling applied. Stress, unhappiness, boredom, and discomfort are lightly limited. Corpse handling no longer affects mood.
